scope: Sixteen dynamics-generated fall diagnostics: nominal standing geometry with prescribed 4 rad/s initial angular velocity about the appropriate wheel-ground support edge, eight directions and two timesteps. Root linear velocity is initialized consistently with that rotation. All subsequent motion uses continuous native dynamics and the frozen sensor-routed get-up. A successful impact recovery additionally requires observed body-ground contact before recovery. This is a finite disturbance screen, not a calibrated physical push, general impact tolerance, randomized fall coverage or strength qualification.
